plays.rationale:
We project NYG +1.5 on the spread at 69.5% true probability vs 49.5% implied at betmgm — about 32.8% expected value.
On this side, 78% of handle vs 49% of tickets (+29% handle-minus-tickets gap) — sharp money signal.
No clear reverse line movement on this market.
Sharp money confirms this side (handle % well above ticket %).

We project HOU +2.5 on the spread at 64.5% true probability vs 50.0% implied at draftkings — about 23.1% expected value.
On this side, 64% of handle vs 43% of tickets (+21% handle-minus-tickets gap) — sharp money signal.
No clear reverse line movement on this market.
Sharp money confirms this side (handle % well above ticket %).

We project HOU ML on the moneyline at 49.5% true probability vs 43.6% implied at draftkings — about 9.0% expected value.
On this side, 61% of handle vs 40% of tickets (+21% handle-minus-tickets gap) — sharp money signal.
No opening line stored yet for RLM. The first pipeline run of the week records the current line as the open; later runs compare movement against it.
Sharp money confirms this side (handle % well above ticket %).
